scope: Manual reading of every accepted row of spx-terminal-register-1.0.0.json (primary) and 1.0.1 (sensitivity) after the runs. The review does NOT change either register; it annotates rows a user should exclude. Review checks: the quote states the consideration for the common shares of the exiting member; it is the final consideration; completion lies in the period; no distribution between t0 and completion is visible in the documents read for this review.

conclusion: 1.0.0 is the primary register (pre-registered rules, corrected implementation); use it without the flagged row (28 usable terminal values). 1.0.1 (after-sight amendment) is a sensitivity only: 19 rows are accepted by both (same values except Biomet), 7 only by 1.0.1 (Columbia Energy, Springs, PeopleSoft, Univision, TXU, Tribune, Rohm & Haas; 2 of them flagged), 10 only by 1.0.0 (incl. the flagged First Data, which 1.0.1 rejects for another reason); 1.0.1 is not adopted.
